landingIntro.faq.item1.a: Yes. The game is fully free, and you can start playing without any payment. From day one you get access to the complete strategic loop: economy, politics, trade, diplomacy, and military conflict.
landingIntro.faq.item2.q: Does the game run in real time?
landingIntro.faq.item2.a: Yes. The world evolves in real time, so political, economic, and military conditions can shift even while you are offline. That makes every decision more impactful and reaction speed essential.
landingIntro.faq.item3.q: Is each match hosted on a separate server?
landingIntro.faq.item3.a: Yes. Every match runs on its own server with a unique map, power balance, alliances, and conflict history. Every start is a fresh scenario with different player dynamics.
landingIntro.faq.item4.q: Can I play solo without an alliance?
landingIntro.faq.item4.a: Yes, but solo play is harder. Alliances provide economic, military, and political advantages.

onboarding.gameGoal.value: The goal is to surpass other countries technologically and militarily. You can do it through diplomacy by building influence and alliances, or through military power by forcing an advantage.
onboarding.seasons.label: How seasons work
onboarding.seasons.value: One season lasts 2 weeks. When it ends, points are reset, the ranking starts over, and everyone competes again for the next season.
onboarding.checklist.item4: The last steps show how to send troops.
onboarding.step1.bullet4: Ranking: opens the leaderboard and ranking views.
onboarding.step1.bullet5: Chat: opens in-game messages and channels.
onboarding.step2.bullet4: Military: builds and upgrades units, then opens the dispatch tools.
onboarding.step2.bullet5: Settings: changes your player preferences and account options.
onboarding.step3.bullet4: Buildings: upgrades country buildings that improve production and defense.
onboarding.step3.bullet5: Wars: declares, tracks and cancels country conflicts.
onboarding.step4.bullet4: Use plus buttons, the max button or manual input to adjust the load.
onboarding.step4.bullet5: Press the send button only after the summary looks correct and you have enough oil.
onboarding.step5.title: Chat button
onboarding.step5.description: This button opens chat. It gives you access to public channels and lets you stay in touch with other players.
onboarding.step6.title: Player overview tab
onboarding.step6.description: This tab is the summary page inside your player modal. It shows the most important account, economy and identity information in one place.
onboarding.step7.title: Inventory tab
onboarding.step7.description: This tab shows what you currently own. Open it to review stored resources, items and other available stock.
onboarding.step8.title: Player trade tab
onboarding.step8.description: This tab focuses on your player trade activity. Use it to inspect offers, transport context and trade-related details for the selected player.
onboarding.step9.title: Military tab
onboarding.step9.description: This tab is your military control room. It is used for unit production, upgrades, active missions and preparing attacks or aid.
onboarding.step10.title: Settings tab
onboarding.step10.description: This tab contains player settings. Open it whenever you want to adjust account or gameplay preferences.
onboarding.step11.title: Country overview tab
onboarding.step11.description: This tab summarizes the country. It shows members, treasury, taxes, combat rules and the most important national status data.
onboarding.step12.title: Council tab
onboarding.step12.description: This tab shows the country leadership structure. Use it to see the president, council members and the current power layout.
onboarding.step13.title: Treasury tab
onboarding.step13.description: This tab is used for country tax management. The president can change tax values and control treasury-related decisions here.
onboarding.step14.title: Buildings tab
onboarding.step14.description: This tab is for country infrastructure. Open it to review and upgrade state buildings that improve production and strategic power.
onboarding.step15.title: Diplomacy tab
onboarding.step15.description: This tab covers wars and external relations. Use it to track conflicts, review opponents and manage country-level military pressure.
onboarding.step16.title: Choose units
onboarding.step16.description: In the military action modal, start by selecting the units and quantities you want to send. The list shows what is available right now.
onboarding.step17.title: Review route and cost
onboarding.step17.description: Before sending troops, read the preview carefully. Check distance, travel time, speed and total oil cost for the planned mission.
onboarding.step18.title: Send the mission
onboarding.step18.description: Send the mission only when the unit mix and summary look correct. The dispatch button should be your final confirmation step.
